name: Barbell Decline Pullover
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a decline, hook your feet, lie back, and hold a barbell shoulder-width over your chest.
Set a slight bend in your elbows, brace your abs, and keep your ribs tucked down.
Lower the bar smoothly in an arc behind your head until your upper arms line up near your ears.
Pull the bar back over your chest along the same arc by engaging your lats and chest.
tips: Hold the slight elbow bend constant so the pullover does not turn into a triceps extension.
Stop lowering before your shoulders feel pinched or your lower back arches sharply off the pad.
